mainEntity.name: How much does Beautiful.ai’s AI presentation maker cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plans start at $12 per month (billed annually) with options for individuals, small teams, startups, and enterprises. A 14-day free trial provides unlimited access to generate content, edit layouts, customize themes, and share presentations.

mainEntity.name: How is Beautiful.ai different from free AI PowerPoint generators?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beautiful.ai combines artificial intelligence, automation, and professional design rules to create polished, work-ready presentations. Smart Slides automate layout, spacing, fonts, colors, and charts, reducing manual edits common with basic AI slideshow makers.

mainEntity.name: How does Beautiful.ai use artificial intelligence in slide design and content creation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The platform uses generative AI and machine intelligence to turn prompts into full decks or single slides, generate images and icons, and power an AI writing assistant for drafting, refining, and summarizing text. Intelligent slides adapt layouts, spacing, fonts, and colors automatically.

mainEntity.name: Can I add my own images, videos, or AI-generated graphics to a slide deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Upload your own logos, photos, videos, and brand assets, and combine them with Beautiful.ai’s library of templates, stock images, icons, posters, and fonts to customize any presentation.

mainEntity.name: Can I share my presentations offline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Download and present offline with the desktop player. Export options include PowerPoint (PPT, PPTX), Google Slides, PDFs, and JPEGs, ensuring compatibility across workflows.

mainEntity.name: Does Beautiful.ai use ChatGPT or other AI chatbots?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beautiful.ai’s AI-powered slide design is driven by advanced large language models (powered by Anthropic) with chatbot-style interfaces to generate content, draft slides in seconds, and refine text or visuals—natively inside the platform.
